Chód: szablon walking-8-frames; W wygenerowany drugi raz (pierwszy miał niebieskie oko i skręcał tułów w klatkach 5-7); SW i SE z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowe SW/SE - także po ponownym losowaniu - obracały się w klatkach 4-7 przodem albo bokiem), klatki 96x96 przycięte jednym oknem (16,16) przed budową (crop_dir.py). Poprawki w zipie (fix_teodor.py): czarny guzek na czubku głowy (podwójny kontur w rotacjach S/SW/SE i w chodzie SE) usunięty, jaskrawe czerwone usta w chodzie S zamienione na stonowany kolor ust z rotacji (98454d), czerwona kreska przy uchu w chodzie NE też. Odznaka znika w chodzie W w klatkach, w których lewa ręka zasłania pierś (naturalne). W NW odznaka wypada na lewym ramieniu/brzegu piersi (tak narysował PixelLab rotację; stała we wszystkich klatkach) - zostawione.

name: Roch Szkwał (przemytnik, przystań)
description: Roch the old sea smuggler, a weathered tough old sailor about 60, deeply tanned wrinkled face, thick full grey-white beard and moustache, a hood of waxed brown canvas pulled up over his head, a gold hoop earring in his ear, a long brown sailor's coat reaching below the knees, open at the front, torn and ragged at the hem after a storm, a dark charcoal-grey waistcoat over a dark shirt under the coat, a leather belt, dark trousers, tall worn dark-brown leather boots, poor medieval smuggler, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Przystań; ten sam człowiek co na planszy prologu (Prolog_Port). Chód E z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowe W i E gubiły długi płaszcz w klatkach 2-7: krótka kurtka i niebieskie spodnie); W = lustro E. Kolczyk schowany pod kapturem (na mapie niewidoczny, jest w popiersiu).

name: Janek (rybak, przystań)
description: Janek the fisherman, a broad-shouldered sturdy man about 40, weather-beaten ruddy tanned face, short reddish-ginger stubble beard and moustache, a navy-blue thick knitted wool cap without a brim pulled down over his head with short reddish hair at the sides, a faded grey-blue linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, a brown leather fisherman's apron over it from chest to knees, a knife in a sheath on his belt, patched dark brown trousers reaching just below the knee, old brown leather boots with high shafts, a small wicker basket carried on his back with shoulder straps, its rim showing behind his shoulder, poor but tidy medieval fisherman, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Przystań. Wiklinowy kosz na plecach (czytelniejszy niż sieć). W = lustro E (szablonowy chód W gubił fartuch, pomarańczowy pas), NE = lustro NW (szablonowy chód NE gubił kosz w klatkach 1-4). Po lustrach nóż u pasa po drugiej stronie w W i NE.

name: Celnik (straż Lorda Zaleskiego, przystań)
description: the harbour customs officer of the lord, a thin stiff older official about 55, very upright rigid posture, short grey hair, grey side whiskers down to the jaw, clean-shaven chin, narrow stern face with thin pressed lips, a small round black felt cap without a brim, a long red official's coat reaching the knees with black trim and a row of buttons down the front, a black rearing horse emblem on the chest, a black leather belt with a ring of iron keys hanging at the hip, black trousers, black leather boots, a thick brown leather-bound ledger book held under his left arm against his side, medieval official in the lord's red livery, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Przystań, komora celna; czerwień jak u Kaprala i Strażnika ((182, 32, 27) / (127, 22, 19)), czarny koń na piersi (na 64 px mały znak). Księga pod lewą pachą: szablonowy chód gubił ją w W, NW, SE (i migała w NE), więc te 4 kierunki z trybu skeleton-v3 (księga w każdej klatce; w NW i SE w klatkach 6-8 kołysze się z ręką). W E i N księgi nie widać (lewa ręka po drugiej stronie) - tak jak w rotacjach.

name: Żołnierz królewski (garnizon nad zatoką)
description: a royal army foot soldier about 25, a round steel kettle helmet with a brim, short brown beard, a pale sky-blue and white tabard with an orange phoenix on the chest over grey chain mail, chain mail sleeves, a brown leather belt with a short sword in a scabbard at the left hip, grey trousers, brown leather boots, plain medieval soldier, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Garnizon (pakiet D). Drugi kolor (wariant B) robi tools/garnizon/art/recolor.py.

name: Rotmistrz Florian Bełza (garnizon nad zatoką)
description: Florian Belza, a royal cavalry captain about 50, weathered stern tired face, short grey hair, a long thick grey drooping moustache, clean-shaven chin, a pale sky-blue and white knee-length tabard over a steel breastplate, a big orange-red phoenix with spread wings on the chest, grey chain mail sleeves, a dark blue sash at the waist, a curved sabre in a black scabbard hanging at his left hip, dark grey trousers, tall black riding boots, medieval royal army officer, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Garnizon (pakiet D). Utyka na lewą nogę tylko w tekstach (szablon chodu).

name: Kwatermistrz Pafnucy Kłos (garnizon nad zatoką)
description: Pafnucy Klos, a royal army quartermaster about 45, very fat with a big round belly, ruddy red cheeks, jolly round face, bald on top with short brown hair at the sides, bushy brown side whiskers, a pale sky-blue and white army tabard with a small orange phoenix on the chest stretched over his belly, a brown leather apron over the tabard, a thick brown leather-bound ledger book held under his left arm, a small wooden abacus hanging from his belt, brown trousers, brown boots, medieval army supply officer, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Garnizon (pakiet D). Fartuch wyszedł biały (nie brązowy) - popiersie tak samo.

name: Eryk Sowa / Ansgar Wiel (rozbitek, tawerna)
description: Ansgar the castaway cartographer posing as a cloth merchant, a thin gaunt man about 35, pale tired face with dark stubble, a thin pale scar over the left eyebrow, dark brown hair tied back in a short ponytail, an oversized worn grey wool coat that is too big for him, sleeves long down over the wrists, a dull grey-brown linen shirt under it, a plain leather belt with a small ink pouch, dark brown trousers, worn dark leather ankle boots, black ink stains on his fingers, poor medieval traveller, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Pakiet E (Wrak). Rozbitek z Białej Źrenicy; w tawernie gosc_9 z danych (Wrak_Data.js).

name: Brat Kleofas (pustelnik na klifie)
description: brother Kleofas, an old hermit monk chronicler about 75, thin, stooped, bald with a white fringe, faded pale blue habit, rope belt with a brass cipher disc, sandals

name: Werbownik Szczepan Bęben (garnizon nad zatoką)
description: Szczepan Beben, a royal army recruiter about 30, lean confident cheerful young man, short dark moustache, a wide-brimmed dark blue felt hat with a long white feather, a pale sky-blue and white doublet with an orange phoenix on the chest, orange stripes on the sleeves, a small red and white military drum hanging at his left hip on a strap, grey trousers, brown knee-high boots, medieval recruiting sergeant, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Garnizon (pakiet D). Bęben u lewego biodra; w chodzie S i NE dorysowany z rotacji (tools/garnizon/art/werbownik_beben.py).

name: Bazyli Krzesiwo (latarnik na przylądku)
description: Bazyli, an old lighthouse keeper about 60, tall and bony, long grey-white hair tied back, left eye clouded, long black sooty waxed coat, belt with tinder pouch and fire striker, small iron lantern at the left hip

name: Kurier w kapturze (goście kantoru nocą, W5)
description: a hooded night courier of a foreign army, black cloak, white eye brooch, satchel

name: Wawrzyn Owczarz (pasterz, Łąka #1 / Map004)
description: Wawrzyn, an old poor shepherd about 55, weathered face, short grey beard, brown felt hat with a soft floppy brim, long brown sheepskin coat with cream wool collar and hem, rope belt with a shepherd's horn, patched trousers, foot wraps, leather shoes, shepherd's crook

name: Hieronim (grabarz, stary cmentarz)
description: Hieronim, an old village gravedigger about 65, stocky and a little stooped, grey stubble beard, dark brown knitted wool cap, long patched earth-brown work coat, grey linen shirt, rope belt, dark grey trousers, worn muddy brown boots

name: Gajowy Gniewko Bór (zwierzyniec Lorda, paczka B)
description: Gniewko Bor, a gamekeeper of a lord's game park, lean weathered man about 40, short dark-brown beard, dark green wool kaftan, brown hood lowered, hunting horn at the hip, longbow on the back, worn leather boots

name: Babka Jagna
description: Babka Jagna, an old forest herb-woman about 75, faded moss-green headscarf, patched dark brown shawl, faded rust-brown dress, wicker basket of herbs on the left forearm, barefoot
notes: Paczka A (Woda i zasoby, docs/rozszerzenia/PLAN.md A5): zielarka z Omszałej łąki (Map017), TownLife 2900; kosz z ziołami na lewym przedramieniu.

name: Szymon Juczny (wędrowny handlarz, drogi)
description: Szymon, a travelling peddler about 40, lean, short dark brown beard, wide-brimmed dark brown travel hat, long dark green hooded travelling cloak, big brown leather pack on his back with a rolled grey blanket, leather pouches at the belt, dark brown trousers, worn brown boots

name: Szczepan Kołodziej (woźnica, stajnia nowego miasta)
description: Szczepan the town carter, a lean wiry man about 40, sun-tanned narrow face, short black beard and short black hair, a faded dark-red cloth kerchief tied over his head, a sleeveless shaggy brown sheepskin vest over a faded blue linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a wide brown leather belt with a coil of rope hanging at his hip, patched grey-brown trousers, worn brown leather shoes with cloth leg wraps
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2940, klucz kolodziej (bo woznica = Wojciech), stajnia z wozownią (Map181).

name: Dorota Igła (szwaczka, dom 3 nowego miasta)
description: Dorota the seamstress, a thin neat woman about 30, narrow pale face, dark brown hair pinned in a tight bun with a few loose strands, a faded plum-purple wool dress with darned elbows, a small white linen collar, a short off-white apron with a small red pincushion at the waist, a yellow measuring cord hanging around her neck, simple dark shoes
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2942, dom 3 (Map184).

name: Agata (przekupka, dom 1 nowego miasta)
description: Agata the market woman, a sturdy cheerful peasant woman about 35, round tanned face, brown hair under a faded mustard-yellow headscarf tied at the back, a dark green laced bodice over an off-white linen blouse with rolled-up sleeves, a long faded brown wool skirt with a patched grey apron, a wicker basket with eggs and onions hanging on her right forearm, simple worn leather shoes
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2941, stragan na placu, dom 1 (Map182). Chód S, N, E, W z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowy gubił kosz i czernił spódnicę w E).

name: Halina (wdowa, dom 4 nowego miasta)
description: Halina the widow, a tired thin woman about 35, pale worn face, a dark grey headscarf covering all her hair, a long plain faded black wool dress of mourning, a patched brown wool shawl over her shoulders, a small empty wooden bucket hanging from her right hand, worn dark shoes
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2943, matka Kostka i Jagódki, dom 4 (Map185). Chód E szablonowy (wiadro schowane za nią), pozostałe 7 kierunków skeleton-v3 (szablonowy gubił i przerzucał wiadro).

name: Jagódka (córka Haliny, ok. 6 lat)
description: Jagodka, a tiny little girl about 6 years old, a very small child about half the height of an adult, round face, dark brown hair in two short pigtails, a faded moss-green linen dress with patches and a small off-white apron, barefoot
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2945, córka Haliny, dom 4 (Map185). Dziecko: zmniejszona --scale 0.66 --head 0.82 (między Elą 0.62 a Zosią 0.70).

name: Leon Dłuto (cieśla, dom 6 nowego miasta)
description: Leon the town carpenter, a broad-shouldered strong man about 45, weathered face, short brown beard with a few grey hairs, short brown hair under a faded grey-blue felt cap, an off-white linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long tan canvas work apron with a front pocket and sawdust on it, a small carpenter's hand axe tucked in his leather belt, dark brown trousers, worn leather boots
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2946, warsztat ciesielski, dom 6 (Map187). Chód W = lustro chodu E (szablonowy W gubił fartuch w połowie klatek).

name: Wacław Siwy (stary żołnierz o kuli, dom 8 nowego miasta)
description: Waclaw the old war veteran, a gaunt old man about 65, weathered lined face with a long drooping white moustache and a scar across his cheek, short cropped grey hair, an old faded dark-blue soldier's coat with tarnished brass buttons, frayed and patched, a grey wool scarf, a simple wooden crutch under his left arm, patched grey trousers, worn old boots
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2947, ławka na placu (plac_1), dom 8 (Map189). Chód od razu w trybie skeleton-v3 (kula w ręku - szablonowy gubi rzeczy trzymane).

name: Kostek (syn Haliny, ok. 8 lat)
description: Kostek, a small peasant boy about 8 years old, a small child much shorter than an adult, thin, messy black hair, a cheeky grin, a too-big faded blue linen tunic with patches and a rope belt, a small wooden toy sword tucked in the belt, short brown trousers torn at the knees, barefoot
notes: Nowe miasto (docs/miasteczko/NOWE_MIASTO.md): TownLife 2944, syn Haliny, dom 4 (Map185). Dziecko: PixelLab narysował go wzrostu dorosłego, zmniejszony --scale 0.74 --head 0.86 (jak Bronek/Franek). Chód N i E miał ciemnoczerwone plamy na spodniach - --recolor na brąz spodni.

name: Wit Zduń (garncarz, garncarnia Nowego Podgrodzia)
description: Wit the village potter, a lean wiry man about 35, narrow face with a short scruffy reddish-brown beard, short curly reddish-brown hair held by a grey cloth headband, a faded brick-red linen tunic with the sleeves rolled up above the elbows, hands and forearms grey with dried clay, a long grey leather apron smeared with clay, patched brown trousers rolled up to the shins, barefoot with clay-caked feet, poor medieval craftsman, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Nowe Podgrodzie (docs/podgrodzie/NOWE_PODGRODZIE.md): TownLife 2952, garncarnia (Map203); ten sam Wit garncarz co na tablicy zleceń (QuestBoard_Data GIVERS.wit).

name: Tośka (dziecko z lepianki 1 Nowego Podgrodzia, ok. 7 lat)
description: Tośka, a small skinny peasant girl about 7 years old, a small child about half the height of an adult, thin freckled face, short choppy uneven straw-blond hair cut like a boy's, a far too big faded ochre-brown sackcloth smock dress reaching below her knees, tied at the waist with a string, a big sewn-on grey patch, grey clay smudges on her hands and shins, barefoot, poor medieval village child, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Nowe Podgrodzie (docs/podgrodzie/NOWE_PODGRODZIE.md): TownLife 2953, klucz dziecko, lepianka 1 (Map204), biega z Frankiem. Dziecko: zmniejszona --scale 0.7 --head 0.84 (jak Zosia, 7 lat). Chód N miał pół sukienki ciemnoszare (szablon) - --recolor na brąz sukienki.

name: Mietek Kwaśniak (szynkarz, szynk Nowego Podgrodzia)
description: Mietek the poor village tavern keeper of a shabby inn, a stout paunchy man about 50, ruddy round face with a red nose, bald crown with a fringe of grey-brown hair, a thick drooping grey-brown moustache, an off-white linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a faded moss-green wool vest left open over it, a long stained dark-brown apron tied at the waist, a dirty grey rag tucked in the apron string, patched grey trousers, worn wooden clogs, poor medieval innkeeper, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Nowe Podgrodzie (docs/podgrodzie/NOWE_PODGRODZIE.md): TownLife 2950, szynk (Map201). Chód W z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowy W i E gubił fartuch i brzuch), chód E = lustro chodu W (własna rotacja E).

name: Ciotka Stefa (opiekunka przytułku Nowego Podgrodzia)
description: Stefa the keeper of the poorhouse, a sturdy kind woman about 55, round weathered face with rosy cheeks and kind tired eyes, grey hair under a plain white linen headscarf tied under the chin, a long faded dark-blue wool dress with patched elbows and the sleeves pushed up, a big off-white apron with a soup stain, a small brown cloth bag of herbs hanging at her hip, worn dark shoes, poor medieval peasant woman, empty hands, full body, standing, facing the viewer
notes: Nowe Podgrodzie (docs/podgrodzie/NOWE_PODGRODZIE.md): TownLife 2951, przytułek (Map202). Chód W z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowy W i E gubił fartuch w części klatek), chód E = lustro chodu W (własna rotacja E). Czerwona plama na fartuchu = barszcz.

name: Podróżna z promu (ciało puli: kobieta w chuście)
description: an ordinary travelling peasant woman about 35, plain kind face, brown hair under a plain dark-red wool headscarf tied under the chin, a long plain dusty-blue wool dress, a simple off-white apron, a brown knitted shawl over the shoulders, worn brown shoes, plain medieval commoner, empty hands, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 7.1): ciało puli K; warianty kolorów K2, K3 kodem (tools/podroznicy/pula_kolory.py).

name: Podróżny z promu (ciało puli: mężczyzna w płaszczu)
description: an ordinary travelling man about 35, plain tanned face, short brown hair and a short brown beard, a long plain dark-green wool travelling cloak fastened at the neck over a simple undyed linen tunic, a leather belt with a small pouch, grey-brown trousers, worn brown leather boots, a small cloth bundle slung on his back, plain medieval commoner, empty hands, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 7.1): ciało puli M; warianty kolorów M2, M3 kodem (tools/podroznicy/pula_kolory.py). Chód N z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowy gubił tobołek na plecach).

name: Podróżny z promu (ciało puli: starzec z laską)
description: an ordinary old travelling man about 70, thin wrinkled face, bald on top with white hair on the sides, a short white beard, a long plain grey-blue wool coat tied with a rope belt, a brown wool scarf, patched brown trousers, worn shoes, leaning on a simple wooden walking stick held in his right hand, plain medieval commoner, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 7.1): ciało puli S; wariant kolorów S2 kodem (tools/podroznicy/pula_kolory.py). Szablonowy chód gubił laskę w W, NW, SW i SE: W = lustro E, NW = lustro NE, SW z trybu skeleton-v3, SE = lustro SW (laska w lewej ręce w tych kierunkach).

name: Podróżny z promu (ciało puli: marynarz)
description: an ordinary sailor about 30, weathered tanned face, short dark stubble, a dark-blue knitted wool cap, a navy-blue wool sailor's jacket over a cream linen shirt, a brown leather belt, loose grey canvas trousers rolled up at the shins, worn brown boots, plain medieval seaman, empty hands, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 7.1): ciało puli Z; wariant kolorów Z2 kodem (tools/podroznicy/pula_kolory.py).

name: Tobiasz Goniec (posłaniec z kontynentu, podróżny z promu)
description: Tobiasz the courier, a lanky young man about 20, quick friendly face, short tousled brown hair, a wide brown felt hat with a grey feather, a mud-spattered dark-blue riding coat, a red neckerchief, a big brown leather letter satchel on a strap worn across the chest, tall worn brown boots, medieval, empty hands, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.1), TownLife 3020, pokój 23. W = lustro E (szablonowy chód W rozjaśniał kapelusz w 7 klatkach).

name: Konstanty Mak (medyk z kontynentu, podróżny z promu)
description: Konstanty the physician, a thin tired man about 45, narrow face, round wire spectacles, short grey hair and a short grey beard, a long dark-green coat, a white linen apron over the coat, a leather bag with herb bundles and small glass vials at the hip, dried herbs tied to the belt, dark trousers, brown boots, medieval, empty hands, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.2), TownLife 3021, pokój 11. W = lustro E (szablonowy chód W gubił fartuch w 4 klatkach), NW = lustro NE (biała plama fartucha w 2 klatkach).

name: Teofil Cyrkiel (kartograf, podróżny z promu)
description: Teofil the cartographer, a stocky man about 50, bald head with grey hair on the sides, bushy grey eyebrows, a brown waistcoat over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, ink-stained fingers, a coiled measuring cord and a brass compass at the belt, a long leather map tube strapped on his back, brown trousers, brown shoes, medieval, empty hands, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.3), TownLife 3022, pokój 22. NE = lustro NW (szablonowy chód NE gubił tubę z mapami w 5 klatkach).

name: Jędrek Dudarz (wędrowny grajek, podróżny z promu)
description: Jedrek the travelling musician, a wiry man about 40, wide grin, stubble, a floppy felt cap with colourful ribbons, a patched colourful vest with red, ochre and green patches over a linen shirt, a bagpipe with a goatskin bag carried under his left arm, grey trousers, bast shoes, medieval, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.4), TownLife 3023, pokój 17. Dudy pod lewą pachą w każdym kierunku; w chodzie SE worek dud chowa się za ręką (widać piszczałki) - zostawione (SE nie wchodzi do arkusza $).

name: Zenon Sita (kupiec zbożowy, podróżny z promu)
description: Zenon the grain merchant, a portly man about 55, round clean-shaven face with a double chin, a flat brown cap, a fine burgundy coat with a brown fur collar, a wide belt with a coin purse and a small brass scale, a sack of grain carried on his right shoulder, dark trousers, brown boots, medieval, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.5), TownLife 3024, pokój 20. Worek zboża na ramieniu w każdym kierunku; w chodzie NW mniejszy w 5 klatkach, w SE prawie schowany za głową - zostawione (diagonale nie wchodzą do arkusza $).

name: Urszula z Olszynki (matka szukająca syna, podróżna z promu)
description: Urszula, a tired peasant woman about 40, kind sad face, a white linen headscarf, a faded grey-blue dress, a brown wool shawl over the shoulders, a small cloth bundle on her back, worn shoes, holding a folded letter in her hands, medieval, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.6), TownLife 3025, pokój 21. Chód N z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowy gubił tobołek na plecach); fioletowe oczy szablonowego chodu S (524493) przekolorowane na brąz z rotacji. W chodzie SW list znika z rąk w 6 klatkach - zostawione (SW nie wchodzi do arkusza $).

name: Gaspar Lis (handlarz relikwii, podróżny z promu, W15)
description: Gaspar the relic seller, a flashy man about 45, curled black moustache, a tall red felt cap, a purple coat with gold trim, many cheap amulets and medallions around the neck, a small wooden tray box on a neck strap in front of his belly holding tiny reliquaries, dark trousers, brown boots, medieval, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.9), łańcuch W15, TownLife 3028, pokój 12. W = lustro E, SE = lustro SW (szablonowe chody W i SE gubiły skrzynkę z relikwiami); kroki arkusza $ 1 i 5 (w klatce 6 chodu E skrzynka znika).

name: Tymon Wrzos (dezerter, podróżny z promu, W16)
description: Tymon, a young soldier about 22, short dark hair, stubble, haunted tired eyes, a torn and dirty white army tunic with an orange phoenix on the chest, rank insignia ripped off, a bandaged left forearm, a plain brown cloak thrown over the shoulders, grey trousers, worn boots, medieval, empty hands, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.11), łańcuch W16, TownLife 3030, pokój 5. Chód N z trybu skeleton-v3 (szablonowy gubił płaszcz w 5 klatkach); fioletowe piksele oczu szablonowego chodu W przekolorowane na brąz; E = lustro W (szablonowy E miał czerwone oczy i czerwono-żółty pas). Szablonowe NW i NE gubią płaszcz - zostawione (poza arkuszem $).

name: Brat Augustyn (wizytator z klasztoru w Lipnicy, podróżny z promu, W15)
description: brother Augustyn, an elderly monk about 65, tonsure with white hair, small round spectacles, kind wrinkled face, a plain black habit, a white rope belt, a leather-bound book held under his left arm, a simple wooden walking stick in his right hand, sandals, medieval, full body, standing, neutral pose, muted earthy medieval palette
notes: Podróżni z promu (docs/PODROZNI.md 2.10), łańcuch W15, TownLife 3029, pokój 16. Szablonowy chód gubił laskę prawie we wszystkich klatkach: S i N z trybu skeleton-v3; W z własnej animacji v3 (1 gen., 'walking slowly in place ... leaning on the wooden walking stick', skeleton-v3 W gubił laskę w klatkach 4-7); E = lustro W (szablonowy E miał też niebieskie szkła okularów). Diagonale szablonowe, bez laski - poza arkuszem $.

name: Szczerba (Dobrawa, łowczyni nagród, podróżna z promu, W16)
